Star Trek: Strange New Worlds | Enterprise Falls Into a Wormhole (S4, E6) | Paramount+
recentItems.description:
Scotty (Martin Quinn) detects a dangerous anomaly, but with the Enterprise at warp speed, there’s no time to avert catastrophe. Now, with the ship’s systems fried, Captain Pike (Anson Mount) and the bridge crew have to think fast to minimize the damage. Season 4, Episode 6: Off-Hour
